title: RAW_UNSCREENED: Bildungsreihenfolge statt hydraulischer Flussrichtung
summary: RAW_UNSCREENED: f77r.14-15 writes qoteedy qokaiin shedy qokeedy qotedy; the sequence can encode condensation then fall or source-to-outlet flow.

design.scope_description: Only already exposed f77r text/labels and cached Aristotle I.9-12 source; no new image or selector.
design.mechanism: Atmospheric reading treats the written order as formation/precipitation stages; hydraulic rival treats it as source, moving content and outlet.
design.unit: Exact whole-form sequences at named f77r loci.
design.contrast: Meteorological formation order versus hydraulic transport order
design.prediction: Meteorology predicts a noncommuting formation order in which phase formation precedes descent; hydraulic reading predicts a directed source-to-carrier-to-endpoint order that should remain stable in other qok/qot sequences.
concrete_observations: GDT932 gives the exact f77r.14 five-form sequence and records its continuation across the f77r.14/.15 boundary.
linked_consequences: A formation model must preserve stage order even when no single carrier is named; a hydraulic model must preserve source/endpoint roles without changing the order relation.
design.nearest_rival: Meteorological formation order versus hydraulic transport order
design.distinguishing_observation: Compare exact order signatures of the same whole forms in f77r.14-15, .23, .27 and .42; distinguish the two order algebras before translating any token.
design.strongest_likely_failure: The same order can be described as either stage sequence or flow, and qok/qot role assignments are unconfirmed.
